source.description: Carries each package's source hash to its dependents, so a check reruns when a package it loads changes, without waiting for that package's checks.

typecheck.description: tsrs -b builds the package's project and the projects it references, so it runs after theirs, and its declarations are its outputs; the shared tsconfig base is an input too.

@grizzle/devtools#typecheck.description: The dev tools and the testing library check with --noEmit: no declarations to cache.

superlint.description: The dev tools' rules and the superlint options in the root package.json are inputs too. It reads the declarations its dependencies' typechecks emit through their project references, so it runs after those typechecks, never while they rewrite them.

oxlint.description: The dev tools' preset and plugin are inputs too.

//#typecheck.description: The tooling project (test, bench, scripts) builds after both packages' projects, which tsrs -b then finds up to date. A root task's inputs are the whole repository.

//#superlint.description: The tooling program follows its project references into both packages' emitted declarations, so it runs after the typechecks that write them.
